description: This file contains a Roslyn analyzer class 'GenerateGenerateSerializerAttributeAnalyzer' that inspects C# code to identify classes, structs, records, and record structs that are not static and lack a specific attribute, then reports diagnostics accordingly.

classes.name: GenerateGenerateSerializerAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer class that checks C# type declarations for specific attribute conditions and reports diagnostics.
